title.zh: 恒星为何发光，表面为何会活动？
title.en: Why stars shine and why their surfaces change

context.zh: 以太阳为例 · 从核心到外层
context.en: THE SUN AS AN EXAMPLE · CORE TO ATMOSPHERE

scale.zh: 左侧保留同一颗太阳的外观与剖面；右侧放大同一处光球局部，按所选步骤突出颗粒、黑子与磁环、短时耀斑或持续外流。黑子只在相关步骤出现，不表示太阳表面处处都有黑子。两侧倍率不同；层厚、颗粒、磁力线和喷流长度均不能按图测量。核心聚变提供长期光热，耀斑释放短时磁能；活动时钟和速度未经标定。
scale.en: The left keeps one Sun's exterior and cutaway; the right enlarges the same photospheric patch, emphasizing granules, spots and field loops, a brief flare, or continuing outflow according to the selected step. Spots appear only where relevant; they are not everywhere on the Sun. The magnifications differ, so layers, granules, field lines and jet lengths are not measurable. Core fusion supplies sustained light and heat; a flare releases magnetic energy briefly. Activity timing is uncalibrated.

section.zh: 同一颗太阳 · 外观与剖面

surface.zh: 同一处光球 · 局部放大

wind.zh: 太阳风 · 日冕物质流出

body.zh: 引力把氢等离子体压到很热、很密。核心把氢聚变成氦，一部分质量转成能量；这持续供给恒星的光和热，不是氧气燃烧。
body.en: Gravity compresses hydrogen-rich plasma to high temperature and density. Core fusion makes helium, converting some mass into energy. This powers long-term starlight and heat, not oxygen-based burning.

boundary.zh: 图中的亮点不是单个核反应的实拍，也没有计算反应速率。
boundary.en: The glow is not a photograph of nuclear reactions and does not calculate their rate.

body.zh: 在太阳辐射区，能量主要靠辐射反复吸收和再发射向外传；进入外部对流区，热等离子体的升降也搬运能量。不是一束光从核心直线冲到表面。
body.en: In the Sun's radiative zone, energy moves through repeated absorption and re-emission; in the outer convective zone, rising and sinking plasma also transports heat. It is not one photon flying straight from core to surface.

boundary.zh: 箭头表示传能方向，不是实际单个粒子的轨迹或传播速度。
boundary.en: Arrows show transport direction, not trajectories or speeds of individual particles.

body.zh: 我们看到的可见表面是光球，不是固体壳。对流抵达这里，形成较亮的颗粒和较暗的颗粒间隙；上方细小喷流属于外层大气的示意，不能把表面看成笔直的地平线。
body.en: The visible surface is the photosphere, not a solid shell. Convection makes brighter granules and darker lanes between them. Fine jets above belong to the outer atmosphere; the surface is not a rigid straight horizon.

boundary.zh: 右图是局部放大示意，颗粒、间隙与喷流的大小及速度均未经观测标定。
boundary.en: The patch is enlarged; sizes and speeds of cells, lanes and jets are not calibrated to observations.

observe.en: Granules, dark lanes and fine jets

body.zh: 穿出光球的强磁场抑制局部对流，区域比周围稍冷，因此显暗。黑子不是太阳表面破了洞，也不代表核心聚变停止。
body.en: Strong magnetic fields emerging through the photosphere suppress local convection. These areas are somewhat cooler and look dark. Sunspots are neither holes nor a shutdown of core fusion.

boundary.zh: 磁力线和黑子位置用于解释关系；这里没有求解太阳磁流体方程。
boundary.en: Field lines and spot positions explain the relationship; no solar magnetohydrodynamics is solved here.

body.zh: 活跃区域的磁场扭曲、重联，短时间释放储存的磁能，产生耀斑。耀斑可以伴随其他喷发，但它本身不是持续的太阳风。
body.en: Twisted magnetic fields in an active region reconnect and briefly release stored magnetic energy as a flare. Flares may accompany other eruptions but are not the steady solar wind.

boundary.zh: 亮弧表示因果位置与短时事件，亮度、形状、时长不按真实耀斑计算。
boundary.en: The bright arc locates a brief event; its brightness, shape and duration are not a calculated flare.

body.zh: 日冕是稀薄的外层大气。一部分带电粒子持续向外流，成为太阳风；其他恒星也可能有恒星风，但强弱和机制细节不全相同。
body.en: The corona is the thin outer atmosphere. Some charged particles continually stream outward as solar wind. Other stars can have stellar winds, but their strengths and details differ.

boundary.zh: 小点展示向外流的方向，不代表单个粒子的真实速度或密度；没有把耀斑误画成恒星风的唯一来源。
boundary.en: Dots show outward flow, not true individual speeds or density; the flare is not presented as the wind's sole source.
